in_marathi.name: Hetvika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wisdom and Intellect
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hetvika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hetvika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'hetu', meaning 'cause' or 'reason'. The name implies a person who is wise and intellectually sharp. In Hindu mythology, Hetvika is a name of a river goddess, symbolizing the power of knowledge and wisdom.
